author: MrinankSharma
text:
i'm really excited and proud to share this latest research ⭐️

it's a first look into how AI assistant usage can change, and even distort, what it means to be human

in the future, it is my hope that AI can be used to magnify, clarify, and support our humanity

quoted.text:
New Anthropic Research: Disempowerment patterns in real-world AI assistant interactions.

As AI becomes embedded in daily life, one risk is it can distort rather than inform—shaping beliefs, values, or actions in ways users may later regret.

Read more: https://t.co/gyMB2AtOuq
